comparison.objective: Bring two free plates together edge-to-edge in midair.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually lift, level, align, and coordinate two independently held plates.
comparison.success_condition: Plates satisfy an 8–25 mm positive gap plus height, yaw, tilt, and midpoint constraints without overlap.
comparison.reason: Bimanual free-body alignment is a different tested ability from one mechanism's fine adjustment and commissioning sequence.
